result.one_liner: GoHighLevel is a sales and marketing platform providing CRM, email, SMS, landing pages, and workflow automation with REST API access for integrations.

evidence.quote: OAuth 2.0 is the standard authentication method for API v2. API v2 also supports API key authentication. Include the key in requests using the Authorization header: Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY.
API access is not available on the entry-level plan. The Unlimited plan removes the sub-account cap and adds API access at $297 per month.
The GoHighLevel API is a REST API that provides programmatic access to the HighLevel platform. All endpoints follow REST conventions with JSON payloads.
GoHighLevel offers 14-30 day free trial with full API access, but permanent API access requires Unlimited plan ($297/month) or higher.

result.notes: GoHighLevel is buildable as an agent toolkit with comprehensive API coverage across contacts, opportunities, calendars, workflows, conversations, and payments. Main limitation is paid subscription requirement ($297+/month minimum). OAuth 2.0 and API keys both documented and production-ready. Access tokens expire every 24 hours requiring refresh token management.
